title: FlightPath Prompt Schema
description: Schema for FlightPath prompts. Prompts should be in final-form format with all context variables (e.g., @workspace, #file:path, #selection) and slash commands (e.g., /fix, /explain) included directly in the prompt text.

originalFile.description: Path to original prompt file (working files only)

startedAt.description: Timestamp when workflow started (working files only)

id.description: Optional unique identifier for this prompt. Used for tracking completion across queue reloads. If omitted, a content hash is used automatically.

prompt.description: The prompt to send to GitHub Copilot. Can be either: (1) Final-form prompt text with context variables (@workspace, #file:path:line-line, etc.) and slash commands (/fix, /explain, etc.) directly in the text, OR (2) A file path to a .prompt.md, .md, or .txt file containing the prompt. File paths are resolved relative to the prompt file's directory, then workspace root, then .flightpath directory. Absolute paths are also supported.

model.description: AI model to use for this prompt. Available models are queried dynamically from your Copilot subscription. Use IntelliSense (Ctrl+Space) to see available models. CLI mode supports limited models (claude-sonnet-4.5, claude-sonnet-4, claude-haiku-4.5, gpt-5) - others will fallback to default with warning. Optional - defaults to flightpath.copilotCliModel setting.

agent.description: Custom agent to use for this prompt (CLI mode only). Specify ONLY the agent name without file extensions (e.g., 'flightpath-orchestrator' for file 'flightpath-orchestrator.agent.md'). The '.agent' suffix is automatically added. Agents are discovered from .github/agents/ or ~/.copilot/agents/. Chat mode cannot programmatically select agents - users must manually select from dropdown. See docs/CHAT_MODE_LIMITATIONS.md for details.

newChatSession.description: Whether to start a new chat session for this prompt. When omitted, defaults to the flightpath.newChatSessionPerPrompt setting (default: true). Set to false to continue in the existing session for context continuity. Retries always use the same session regardless of this setting.

allowDynamicExtension.description: If true, inject instructions for extending the queue. If false, never inject. If omitted, defaults to true for last prompt only (when no other prompts have explicit flags).

script.description: Path to script file to execute, or direct shell command (e.g., 'npm test', 'python script.py'). File paths are resolved relative to workspace root or .flightpath directory.

returns.description: Expected output from script (stdout). Matching rules: (1) Exact match (case-insensitive), (2) Boolean: 'true' matches true/1/yes/pass/passed, 'false' matches false/0/no/fail/failed, (3) Numeric: compared as >= (e.g., '90' matches if script outputs 90 or higher), (4) Substring: matches if output contains this string

maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts when validation fails. Use -1 for unlimited retries (use with caution), 0 for no retries (default), or 1-100 for a specific limit.

retryPrompt.description: Template for retry prompt with placeholders: {scriptOutput}, {errorOutput}, {expectedValue}, {actualValue}, {retryCount}, {maxRetries}

runtimeMetadata.description: Runtime execution state for working files (optional, added automatically by FlightPath during execution)

completedPrompts.description: Array of completed prompt IDs and hashes

appendSegment.description: Metadata about a queue append operation

timestamp.description: When the append occurred (ms since epoch)

source.description: Source of the append (e.g., 'User append', 'MCP tool', 'copilot-cli')

promptCount.description: Number of prompts added in this segment

promptIndices.description: Indices of prompts in this segment
